name: Dire Maul North: Stomper Kreeg polymorphs and spits on the damage dealer, never on the tank (#11456)
contract: Stomper Kreeg 14322 is a Dire Maul (map 429, expansion 0) encounter boss. His Ascension kit casts Polymorph
2100019 at a random player (event 9005, first after 6-9 s, then every 18-22 s) and Booze Spit 22833, a 75% hit
chance reduction in an 18 yd frontal cone (event 9004, first after 8-12 s, then every 16-21.3 s since #11456).
#11456: he polymorphed the tank and kept its hit chance down. Both spells now follow the vanilla dungeon boss
control rule (BossControlTargeting): a tank or healer specialization is never their target, and Booze Spit's
cone leaves them out. Vanguard 21 tanks and Boltslinger 10 deals damage. The tank engages first and holds
threat, so Booze Spit's cone faces the tank; the damage dealer is on the threat list. The players are level 60
humans with health fixtures; the boss is summoned at its own stats in the group's instance.
